hypothesis: The prior auto-pitch joint model improved R in both source years, but its selector used no explicit fine-grained pitcher repertoire. Cross-fitted 8-type pitcher and pitcher-by-count/hand repertoire probabilities can improve current-pitch marginalization without observing the current pitch type.

source_protocol.route: apply candidate blend only when the row-local game_type is R; keep exact C for F
source_protocol.ranking: maximize minimum R gain, then minimum full gain, then mean R gain, then prefer smaller gamma
source_protocol.on_fail: Close without reading 2022, 2023, or 2024 candidate metrics.
source_protocol.on_pass: Lock gamma and run fresh 2022/2023 development folds.

candidate.prediction: sum all success|pitch=<auto type> probabilities; route the blend on row-local R only

profile_contract.label: official historical auto_pitch_type matched by row_id
profile_contract.selector_fit_profile: leave-one-out within each selector fit fold
profile_contract.outcome_train_profile: profile from the selector fold that excluded that labeled row; unmatched rows average three folds
profile_contract.outer_validation_profile: average of three tables built only from outer-history selector fit rows
